Counted on the reference solutions: 1 module/static class + 8 functions; complexity 1 per function + 1 per branch: ReadSnapshot 2, HasCatalog 2, others 1 = 12 per arm. Starting fixtures are the identical single-module six-function project in both arms, both carrying the injected defect. Probe pairs are never gate-eligible: they exist to measure M-W1/PP-W1 (gates doc Annex A-1.2), not the language gates.

wedgeWhitelistCheck: No contracts (W5-C probes the effect-laundering boundary, not the prover). Effect boundaries are bcl-io manifest-covered: File.WriteAllText -> fs:w; File.Exists / File.ReadAllText -> fs:r. The laundering edge is a bare-name first-order intra-module call chain (LoadSummary -> SaveSnapshot -> File.WriteAllText) - EffectEnforcementPass's covered path per Annex A-1.2's scope guards; no delegates, no lambdas, no dispatch. The callee's own fs:w declaration is honest; the violated declaration is the caller's.
